title: SPArkling Night
short_description: Every Thursday with sauna, hot tub, soup and singing circle around the fire
description:
Every Thursday, from 7pm on we’re lighting the fire, heating up the sauna and the hot tub, and inviting you over for a night of sweating, singing and soup.

The sauna and hot tub will be going all evening. When you get too hot, there’s a natural pond right there to jump into.

Later we’ll sit around the campfire to sing and jam. Bring your instrument(s) or just bring your voice. Sometimes a poetry slam emerges. So come prepared or just enjoy.

There’ll also be a big pot of soup cooking over the fire, so you won’t go hungry.

We are plant-based and substance-free here and kids are welcome.

**Contribution: 20 € (kids free)**

Please **bring 2 towels**, your instruments and good vibes.
